caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a rectangular, open-topped box with slightly flared sides and one end that rises higher and curves outward. The box is predominantly red in color with decorative patterns. The upper inner rim, the inner back, and the curled-outward end are adorned with green panels featuring stylized, multicolored leaf and floral motifs in yellow, gold, and black with some white accents. The inside bottom of the box contains additional decorative elements with similar leaf patterns. The exterior and less decorated portions of the box are primarily solid red, with some small white marks or highlights. The drawing is set on a plain, light beige or off-white background, and the perspective shows the box at an angle to reveal both its depth and decorated surfaces. The artist’s name, "Mildred Bird," is written in the lower right corner.
title: Toleware Bread Tray
